description: Source code for the SpatializerPoseController class, managing head and screen pose tracking, sensor integration, and pose prediction for spatial audio in Android.

classes.name: SpatializerPoseController
classes.description: Manages head and screen pose tracking, sensor data processing, and pose prediction for spatial audio.

methods.name: SpatializerPoseController
methods.description: Constructor initializing the pose controller with listener, sensor period, and optional max update period.

methods.name: ~SpatializerPoseController
methods.description: Destructor that signals thread termination and joins the thread.

methods.name: setHeadSensor
methods.description: Sets the sensor for head tracking, manages sensor start/stop, and recenters pose.

methods.name: setScreenSensor
methods.description: Sets the sensor for screen tracking, manages sensor start/stop, and recenters pose.

methods.name: setDesiredMode
methods.description: Sets the desired head tracking mode.

methods.name: setScreenToStagePose
methods.description: Sets the pose from screen to stage.

methods.description: Waits until pose calculation is complete.

methods.description: Returns a string representation of the controller's current state for debugging.
